title: The visual director's answer for the text pass (S9b): the caption chunks as word groups, the card texts it changes, the labels

words.description: the next spoken body words, exactly as written in the timeline, in order: 1 to 4 for a word run, 2 to 6 for a group

emphasis.description: the words of this chunk that get the accent box (0 to 3)

mode.description: word: the words appear one at a time; group: the words fill the hero zone as kinetic typography (2 to 6 words, only where no other text is on screen). Leave it out to let the pipeline choose.

anchor.description: group mode: the most important word of the group (it is drawn biggest)

chunks.description: every spoken word of the body beats (not the hook, not the ask), in order, grouped into word runs of 1 to 4 words and groups of 2 to 6

component.description: the instance id from the scenes list (s2-card-1)

prop.description: the text prop: title, body, text, kicker, keyword, line1, line2, message, label, unit, items_json or lines_json (lines separated by |)

cards.description: the on-screen texts you change (the rest keep the animations pass's draft)

labels.description: small tags worth noting per scene (the honesty labels come from the components themselves)
